text:
Predicates:
Contain(x, y) ::: x contains y.
Read(x, y) ::: x reads y.
Gain(x, y) ::: x gains y.
Smarter(x) ::: x is smarter.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
Premises:
∀x (Book(x) → Contain(x, knowledge)) ::: Books contain tons of knowledge.
∀x ∀y (Person(x) ∧ Read(x, y) → Gain(x, knowledge)) ::: When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
∀x (Gain(x, knowledge) → Smarter(x)) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Read(harry, walden) ::: Harry read the book “Walden” by Henry Thoreau.
Conclusion:
Contain(walden, knowledge) ::: Walden contains knowledge.
